functions.name: SGV
functions.code:
function SGV takes nothing returns nothing
set QV=GetTriggerUnit()
set SV=GetSpellTargetUnit()
set TV=DistanceBetweenPoints(GetUnitLoc(QV),GetUnitLoc(SV))
call TriggerSleepAction(.02)
call PauseUnit(QV,true)
call PauseUnit(SV,true)
call SetUnitPathing(QV,false)
call SetUnitFacingToFaceUnitTimed(QV,SV,0)
call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("left hand",QV,"Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\LightningShield\\LightningShieldTarget.mdl")
set UV=bj_lastCreatedEffect
call SetUnitAnimation(QV,"spell Death")
call EnableTrigger(BU)
call TriggerSleepAction((TV/ 600.))
call DisableTrigger(BU)
call SetUnitAnimation(QV,"Stand")
call DestroyEffect(UV)
set PE=GetUnitLoc(SV)
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(PE,"Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Thunderclap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl")
set IX=bj_lastCreatedEffect
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(PE,"Abilities\\Weapons\\Bolt\\BoltImpact.mdl")
set AX=bj_lastCreatedEffect
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(PE,"Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\ManaFlare\\ManaFlareBoltImpact.mdl")
set NX=bj_lastCreatedEffect
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h019',Player($F),PE,bj_UNIT_FACING)
if(SEV())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(QV,SV,900.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
if(SXV())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(QV,SV,1200.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
if(SOV())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(QV,SV,1500.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(GetUnitLoc(SV),"Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\Stampede\\StampedeMissileDeath.mdl")
set VR[0]=bj_lastCreatedEffect
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02I',GetOwningPlayer(QV),GetUnitLoc(SV),GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02I',GetOwningPlayer(QV),GetUnitLoc(SV),GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02I',GetOwningPlayer(QV),GetUnitLoc(SV),GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call RemoveLocation(PE)
if(SFV())then
call ForGroupBJ(A_V(300.,GetUnitLoc(SV)),function SDV)
else
if(SBV())then
call ForGroupBJ(A_V(400.,GetUnitLoc(SV)),function SNV)
else
call ForGroupBJ(A_V(500.,GetUnitLoc(SV)),function SIV)
endif
endif
call SetUnitPathing(QV,true)
call PauseUnit(SV,false)
call PauseUnit(QV,false)
call TriggerSleepAction(2)
call DestroyEffect(VR[0])
call DestroyEffect(VR[1])
call DestroyEffect(VR[2])
call DestroyEffect(IX)
call DestroyEffect(AX)
call DestroyEffect(NX)
set TE=A0V('h019')
call RemoveUnit(GroupPickRandomUnit(TE))
call DestroyGroup(TE)
endfunction

functions.name: MXV
functions.code:
function MXV takes nothing returns nothing

functions.name: UOV
functions.code:
function UOV takes nothing returns nothing
set NA=GetSpellAbilityUnit()
set VI=GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
set UR=GetSpellTargetLoc()
set TR[0]=AYV(200.,UR,Condition(function T_V))
set TR[1]=AYV(275.,UR,Condition(function T2V))
set TR[2]=AYV(350.,UR,Condition(function T5V))
if(UEV())then
call ForGroupBJ(TR[0],function UVV)
else
if(T9V())then
call ForGroupBJ(TR[1],function T8V)
else
if(T7V())then
call ForGroupBJ(TR[2],function T6V)
endif
endif
endif
call RemoveLocation(VI)
call RemoveLocation(UR)
call DestroyGroup(TR[0])
call DestroyGroup(TR[1])
call DestroyGroup(TR[2])
set YR=A0V('h02M')
call TriggerSleepAction(5.)
call ForGroupBJ(YR,function UXV)
call DestroyGroup(YR)
endfunction

call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h019',GetOwningPlayer(GV),AE,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02I',GetOwningPlayer(GV),AE,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02I',GetOwningPlayer(GV),AE,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02I',GetOwningPlayer(GV),AE,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
if(G_E())then
if(GWE())then

endif
if(GYE())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GV,HV,1500.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
if(GZE())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GV,HV,2000.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)

else

call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GV,HV,1500.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
if(GTE())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GV,HV,2000.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
if(GUE())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GV,HV,2500.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
endif
if(HKE())then
set CE=PIV(400.,AE,Condition(
function G4E))
call ForGroupBJ(CE,
function HJE)
else
if(HFE())then
set CE=PIV(500.,AE,Condition(
function HRE))
call ForGroupBJ(CE,
function HDE)
else
set CE=PIV(600.,AE,Condition(
function G9E))
call ForGroupBJ(CE,

endif
endif
